# The box decides the bill, not the item.

> Work out the billable weight of a parcel from its box size, weight and DIM divisor — then see the box size that stops you paying for air, and whether the carton trips an additional-handling or oversize surcharge.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
